question: Which is one of the bi-product formed when sodium sulphate reacts with barium chloride?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Sodium chloride. **__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• When sodium sulfate reacts with barium chloride, one of the by-products formed is sodium chloride.
 
• This reaction is a double displacement reaction, where the sodium and barium ions switch partners to form new compounds.
 
• Sodium chloride is a common salt that is used in various industries, such as food and chemical manufacturing.
